milestones.description: Upstream llama.cpp integration, CMake build configuration with embedded Metal, C staging shim, and C-ABI verification tests

milestones.name: odin-package
milestones.description: Native Odin package implementation including foreign C bindings, idiomatic generator abstraction, MTP speculative decoding driver, and Odin unit tests

milestones.name: ci-release

tasks.title: Integrate upstream llama.cpp dependency
tasks.description:
Track upstream llama.cpp repository via Git submodule (pinned to stable commit e.g. b3800+) or vendored in vendor/llama.cpp, ensuring ggml and internal headers (such as llama-ext.h) required by the staging shim are accessible.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Upstream llama.cpp source tracked via submodule or vendored path
- Core headers (llama.h, ggml.h, llama-ext.h) accessible for build system
- Clean integration without unintended modifications to upstream files

tasks.title: Implement unified C-ABI header and C++ extension shim
tasks.description:
Create include/llama_odin.h and src/llama_odin_ext.cpp. Expose extern "C" interface for LLAMA_ODIN_ABI_VERSION, llama_odin_abi_version(), llama_odin_silence_logs() (using a null log callback), and Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) staging procedures (llama_odin_set_embeddings_nextn, llama_odin_get_embeddings_nextn, llama_odin_get_embeddings_nextn_ith, llama_odin_set_nextn_layer_offset, and llama_odin_get_ctx_other). Provide include/llama.h for downstream consumers.

Acceptance Criteria:
- include/llama_odin.h defines LLAMA_ODIN_ABI_VERSION 1 and declares all wrapper functions
- src/llama_odin_ext.cpp implements extern "C" shims wrapping llama-ext.h functions
- Log silencing sets null log callback via llama_log_set
- include/llama.h correctly placed in include directory

tasks.title: Configure root CMake build system with embedded Metal
tasks.description:
Implement root CMakeLists.txt to build libllama_odin shared and static library targets. Configure C++17 and position-independent code. On macOS, force GGML_METAL=ON, GGML_METAL_EMBED_LIBRARY=ON, CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES='arm64', dynamic library install name to '@rpath', SOVERSION 1, VERSION 1.0.0, and link Metal, Foundation, and Accelerate frameworks. On Linux and Windows, configure standard compilation targets and export rules.

Acceptance Criteria:
- CMake builds shared and static library targets across target platforms
- On macOS, Metal shaders compiled into binary bytecode at build time with GGML_METAL_EMBED_LIBRARY=ON
- Dynamic library configured with MACOSX_RPATH ON and INSTALL_NAME_DIR '@rpath' on macOS
- Builds cleanly on macOS arm64, Linux x86_64, and Windows x64

tasks.title: Implement and execute C-ABI sanity test suite
tasks.description:
Implement tests/c/test_abi.c to verify C-ABI compatibility and symbol visibility. Verify llama_backend_init(), llama_odin_abi_version() == 1, llama_odin_silence_logs(), GPU backend device enumeration via ggml_backend_dev_*, and llama_backend_free(). Validate symbol exports on libllama_odin.dylib using nm -gU.

Acceptance Criteria:
- tests/c/test_abi.c compiles and links against libllama_odin
- Running test_abi passes all assertions on macOS arm64
- nm -gU libllama_odin.dylib confirms llama_odin_* and llama_* symbols are cleanly exported

tasks.title: Implement low-level Odin foreign C declarations
tasks.description:
Create odin/c/llama_c.odin with cross-platform foreign import directives for libllama_odin (system:libllama_odin.dylib on Darwin, libllama_odin.so on Linux, and llama_odin.lib on Windows). Declare low-level foreign procedures and structs for: backend lifecycle (llama_backend_init/free), ABI version and logging, hardware device enumeration (ggml_backend_dev_*), model and vocab (llama_model_*, llama_vocab_*, llama_tokenize, llama_token_to_piece), context and execution (llama_context_*, llama_batch_*, llama_decode, llama_get_logits_ith), samplers (llama_sampler_*), and MTP staging (llama_odin_*).

Acceptance Criteria:
- odin/c/llama_c.odin defines package llama_c with cross-platform foreign import blocks (Darwin, Linux, Windows)
- Structs, pointers, token types, and procedure signatures match C-ABI definitions
- Code compiles cleanly with Odin compiler across target platforms

tasks.title: Implement high-level Odin generator package
tasks.description:
Implement odin/llama/llama.odin providing idiomatic Odin types and procedures: Device_Info, Device_Kind, devices() -> []Device_Info for hardware discovery, Generator_Config (model path, layers, speculative settings), Llama_Generator struct (encapsulating model, context, batch, sampler chain), generator_new(cfg) -> (^Llama_Generator, string), and generator_generate(g, prompt, turns, max_tokens, stop_seqs, cancel_flag, on_token, on_progress, user_data) supporting streaming tokens and cancellation.

Acceptance Criteria:
- odin/llama/llama.odin exposes idiomatic Device_Info and devices() helper
- Llama_Generator properly initializes model, context, and samplers via generator_new
- generator_generate streams generated tokens via callback and handles stop sequences and cancellation
- Proper resource cleanup procs implemented

tasks.title: Implement Odin Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) driver
tasks.description:
Implement odin/llama/mtp.odin to support Multi-Token Prediction speculative decoding. Drive draft token prediction, next-n embedding staging via llama_odin_set_embeddings_nextn, llama_odin_get_embeddings_nextn_ith, and llama_odin_set_nextn_layer_offset, and token verification against the primary context.

Acceptance Criteria:
- odin/llama/mtp.odin implements MTP speculative driver logic
- Correctly configures next-n embedding staging and offset calls
- Integrates seamlessly with Llama_Generator speculative decoding options

tasks.title: Implement Odin test suite
tasks.description:
Create tests/odin/test_generator.odin to test native Odin bindings and generator functions. Verify backend device enumeration returns valid Metal GPU devices on macOS Apple Silicon, test vocabulary lookup and tokenization/piece decoding helpers, and test generator initialization. Execute tests via 'odin test tests/odin/ -define:ODIN_TEST_THREADS=1'.

Acceptance Criteria:
- tests/odin/test_generator.odin created with test procedures
- Verifies Metal GPU enumeration on Apple Silicon
- Tests tokenization and vocab helpers
- 'odin test tests/odin/ -define:ODIN_TEST_THREADS=1' runs and passes cleanly

tasks.title: Create CI test workflow in .github/workflows/test.yml
tasks.description:
Create .github/workflows/test.yml GitHub Actions workflow for pull requests and pushes to main/master matching natelong/harper-odin parity (omitting x86 OSX):
- Multi-platform test matrix: macos-latest (Apple Silicon arm64), ubuntu-latest (Linux x86_64), and windows-latest (Windows x64).
- Setup Odin compiler using laytan/setup-odin@v2 with token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}.
- Verify Odin installation via odin version.
- Build libllama_odin shared and static libraries via CMake (with embedded Metal on macOS, and standard CPU targets on Linux and Windows).
- Run C-ABI sanity test suite (tests/c/test_abi.c).
- Run Odin test suite: odin test tests/odin/ -define:ODIN_TEST_THREADS=1.

Acceptance Criteria:
- .github/workflows/test.yml configured with multi-platform matrix (macos-latest, ubuntu-latest, windows-latest)
- Triggers on push and pull_request to main and master
- Sets up Odin compiler via laytan/setup-odin@v2
- Builds native libraries and executes both C-ABI and Odin test suites successfully across all matrix platforms

tasks.title: Create multi-platform release workflow in .github/workflows/release.yml
tasks.description:
Create .github/workflows/release.yml GitHub Actions workflow matching natelong/harper-odin parity (omitting x86 OSX):
- Triggers on tag pushes (v*) and workflow_dispatch with publish_release (boolean) and tag_name (string) inputs.
- Permissions: contents: write.
- Multi-platform build matrix:
  - macos-14: target aarch64-apple-darwin, lib_ext dylib, lib_static libllama_odin.a (embedded Metal: -DGGML_METAL=ON -DGGML_METAL_EMBED_LIBRARY=ON -DCMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES="arm64")
  - ubuntu-latest: target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, lib_ext so, lib_static libllama_odin.a
  - windows-latest: target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, lib_ext dll, lib_static llama_odin.lib (including import library)
  (macos-13 / x86_64-apple-darwin excluded per instructions).
- Flexible version determination supporting workflow_dispatch input, tag push GITHUB_REF_NAME, or short sha fallback.
- Package release tarball llama-odin-${TARGET}-${VERSION}.tar.gz containing:
  - lib/ (static and dynamic libraries)
  - include/ (include/llama_odin.h and include/llama.h)
  - odin/ (package sources)
  - LICENSE and README.md
- Generate internal manifest checksums.txt inside archive and standalone ${ARCHIVE_NAME}.sha256 file.
- Upload matrix artifacts via actions/upload-artifact@v4 (name: artifacts-${{ matrix.target }}).
- Two-stage publish job on ubuntu-latest:
  - Download all build artifacts via actions/download-artifact@v4 (pattern: artifacts-*, merge-multiple: true).
  - Generate consolidated checksums.txt across all platform tarballs.
  - Publish assets to GitHub Release via softprops/action-gh-release@v2 with generate_release_notes: true.

Acceptance Criteria:
- .github/workflows/release.yml implements full two-stage matrix build and publish pipeline
- Targets macOS arm64, Linux x86_64, and Windows x64 (excluding x86 OSX)
- Supports both tag push and manual workflow_dispatch triggering
- Generates per-archive and consolidated SHA-256 checksum manifests and publishes to GitHub Releases

tasks.title: Create project documentation and license
tasks.description:
Create LICENSE with standard MIT license text and README.md with comprehensive documentation. Document project mission, prerequisites (macOS arm64, Xcode/Metal, CMake, Odin), build commands, directory structure, low-level C bindings usage, high-level Odin generator usage (including streaming and stop sequences), MTP speculative decoding instructions, and release workflow details.

Acceptance Criteria:
- LICENSE file created containing valid MIT license
- README.md provides complete quickstart, build commands, and Odin API code examples
- Accurately details embedded Metal architecture and MTP speculative decoding

tasks.title: ggml-metal build in vendored fork embeds Metal kernel source (jit at runtime) under GGML_METAL_EMBED_LIBRARY=ON; evaluate adding build-time .metallib bytecode embedding for strict spec compliance
Hide C++-mangled llama internals from libllama_odin exported C-ABI surface (visibility: hidden / version script)
Address review feedback: Implement Odin test suite
tasks.description:
Feedback for merge m-4fa65e (branch 'feat/t-3eab27'):
All 11 tests pass, but the run emits Odin 'bad free' diagnostics in test code. Root causes: (1) test_generator.odin find_test_model: best/best_path can be assigned strings not allocated with default_allocator (e.g. walker fi.name), then freed by the deferred mem.delete_string — free only strings this proc itself allocated (clone into best/best_path or track ownership). (2) vocabulary_reports_bos_n_tokens_eog line 239: bad free in the deferred cleanup — load_test_model must return a path that is always default_allocator-owned (including on the failure path) or the caller must not delete it; align ownership with clone semantics. Fix both, rerun 'odin test tests/odin/ -define:ODIN_TEST_THREADS=1' until 'All tests were successful' with ZERO bad-free/leak diagnostics, then resubmit.
